entities.name: Getting Started
entities.description: How to begin a Dungeons run - picking a class, gear and a dungeon.
tips: Pick your class before the run - Ranger and Fighter are the easiest starts.
Start with the first dungeon and its Captured Mosaic to unlock the shop.
Always take the free daily rewards - the Merchant's Guild gives gear and gold.
Do not spend gold on weapons until you have armour for the level you are on.
The Ancient Hunts are the endgame loop - run them once you have a Unique or Epic.

entities.name: Classes
entities.description: Five classes, each with a different role and starting gear.
tips: Ranger - ranged bow user, good at kiting. Easiest class for beginners.
Fighter - melee with a sword and a shield, high survivability and a roll attack.
Rogue - melee with daggers and a smoke bomb, the highest damage and the squishiest.
Mage - ranged magic, the highest damage but the weakest defence.
Warlock - summons devils that fight for you and draw aggro.
The class changes your weapons - a Rogue cannot use a bow well and a Mage is poor with a sword.

entities.name: Weapons
entities.description: The weapon pool, their melee and ranged stats, and how rarity affects them.
tips: Rarity order is Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Unique - the higher the rarity the better the damage and the more sockets.
Weapon damage scales with the dungeon level - upgrade before moving up a level.
Melee and ranged are separate stats - a weapon can be great at one and poor at the other.
Sockets let you roll the enchantments you want - the fastest way to a build.
Do not buy from the Merchant before you have found better - the merchant prices are steep.

entities.name: Armor
entities.description: Armour pieces, their sockets and the enchantments worth chasing.
tips: Armour has three sockets, and the higher the rarity the better the socket roll.
Protection enchantment reduces incoming damage - the most important stat for a beginner.
Thorns damage reflects damage back at attackers - strong on tanks.
Soul Speed, Swift Sneak and other movement enchantments are the best filler.
The enchantment table lets you re-roll a socket - farm gold to use it.

entities.name: Caves
entities.description: The levels you play through - standard levels, jungle levels and the endless arena.
tips: Each level has a Captured Mosaic to collect - get all three and the level is cleared.
Jungle Awakens added jungle levels with new enemies and new loot.
The Ancient Hunts are the repeatable endgame mode with a difficulty scale.
Farm the levels you have cleared - difficulty scales and so do the drops.
Do the free-standing secret arenas for the free loot and the extra chests.

entities.name: Bosses
entities.description: The bosses of each biome and how to beat them.
tips: Each boss has a clear pattern - learn the attack and the counter.
Arch Illager fires arrows that you can dodge by moving off the line.
The Jungle Awakens bosses have new mechanics - watch the ground and the summons.
Use the potion of healing between phases rather than trying to tank everything.
Bosses drop the best gear for that biome - farm them for Unique items.

entities.name: Redstone
entities.description: Redstone farms for gold, xp and uniques.
tips: Redstone Mines has the classic farm routes for gold and emerald farming.
Gold from the mines levels up your enchantment table - farm it early.
The farm in the Ancient Hunt gives uniques - run it repeatedly.
Gold summons the Enchantment Table merchant - spend gold on re-rolling sockets.
Farm with the right class - a Ranger can shoot the farm from a safe distance.

entities.name: Mobs
entities.description: The enemy roster and which ones are dangerous.
tips: Zombies, skeletons and creepers appear in the Overworld levels - creepers are the nuisance, they explode at close range.
The Jungle Awakens added new jungle mobs - some can be very dangerous in groups.
Archers shoot from range - use a shield or roll through the shot.
Blaze mobs and ranged enemies punish standing still.
Pull one enemy at a time - a group at once is how runs end early.
